open OldExpressions in
theorem extractedOldExprInVars :
  NormalizedOldExpr post →
  (extractOldExprVars post).Subset
  (Imperative.HasVarsPure.getVars post) := by
  intros Hnorm x Hin
  induction post <;> simp [extractOldExprVars, Imperative.HasVarsPure.getVars, List.Subset, List.mem_append, List.mem_singleton] at * <;> try simp_all
